title: LDS-LOG-01 Leeds stores
summary: Cost centre for Leeds stores in operating unit NBC-LDS-01 managed by BPRICE, with £77,999.45 available budget for 2026-Q4.
body:
Cost centre LDS-LOG-01 covers Leeds stores operations within operating unit NBC-LDS-01 under owner BPRICE[^r1]. It holds an OPEN status in the master records[^r1]. As of 26 October 2026 09:00, the cost centre has an allocated 2026-Q4 budget of £125,000, committed spend of £47,000.55, and an available balance of £77,999.45[^r2].

## Details

Cost centre LDS-LOG-01 is assigned to operating unit NBC-LDS-01 and operates under the management of BPRICE with an active status of OPEN[^r1]. 

## Budget position

For 2026-Q4, as of 26 October 2026 09:00, the financial master shows the following position for LDS-LOG-01[^r2]:

| Field | Amount |
|---|---|
| Budget | £125,000 |
| Committed spend | £47,000.55 |
| Available budget | £77,999.45 |

Full cost centre registers and quarterly tracking are maintained in [[data-cost-centres-and-budgets|Cost Centres and Budgets FY2026-27]][^r1][^r2].
